name: Click Advance Forms Builder
author: sykologicist

sections.description:
Advance Forms Builder is the most intuitive, feature-rich, and developer-friendly drag-and-drop WordPress forms plugin. Designed to help you build everything from a simple contact form to complex multi-step forms, school admission requests, job applications, and online order checkouts in minutes without writing a single line of code.

Whether you need a free form builder to collect subscriber emails or a premium form builder to capture leads, process payments, and automate user registration, Advance Forms Builder delivers a high-speed, mobile-responsive experience out-of-the-box.

Why Choose Advance Forms Builder?

  • Intuitive Drag & Drop Builder: Build beautiful forms directly inside a modern canvas editor with instant live preview.
  • 100% Mobile Responsive Layouts: Every form you design fits seamlessly on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices automatically.
  • Paginated Multi-Step Forms: Increase form conversions by breaking long forms into step-by-step pages with beautiful progress bars and indicators.
  • 13+ Pre-made Form Templates (Free): Launch instantly with basic layouts including Contact Us, Newsletter Sign-up, RSVP, Bug Report, lead capture, and appointment bookings.
  • 8+ Advanced Form Templates (Pro): Unlock complex configurations like Job Applications with file uploads, Patient Intake, Real Estate Listings, Course Reviews, and IT incident tickets.
  • Gutenberg & Shortcode Integrations: Embed your forms anywhere inside posts, pages, or widgets using our native Gutenberg Block or simple shortcode generator.

Key Free Features:

  • Drag & Drop Form Editor.
  • Multi-Step Forms with Page Indicators.
  • Email Notifications on Form Submissions.
  • Custom Redirects or Success Confirmation Messages.
  • Input Field Types: Text, Email, Phone, Number, Dropdown Select, Checkbox, Radio, Date, File Upload, URL, and Hidden fields.
  • Template Library Modal to start with blank canvas or pre-made basic layouts.

Key Pro Features (Unlock Premium Power):

  • Premium Fields: Signature Pad, Rating Stars, Range Sliders, Address Auto-complete (Google Maps API), Repeater Fields, and Password Strength meters.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track views, submissions, and conversion rates, along with page drop-off analytics.
  • Pricing Card Integration: Sell licenses, handle subscriptions, and manage licensing activations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clicks-advance-forms-builder directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Click on the “Advance Forms” menu in the sidebar to create your first form.
  4. Place the shortcode [clicks_form id="YOUR_FORM_ID"] on any page, post, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I embed a form?

Use the shortcode [clicks_form id="X"] where X is the ID of your form, which you can find on the Forms Dashboard.

What file types are allowed for upload?

By default, the plugin supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, and ZIP.
